integrity: Complete algebraic proof and deterministic exact verification are included; exploratory finite sampling is not used to certify infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the full six-edge squarefree quadratic subspace of the complex four-torus only; no higher-dimensional or order-two Walsh conclusion. Bibliographic priority has not undergone independent review.
title: Sharp fourth moment and complete complex equality cases for the tetrahedral squarefree Fourier chaos
